verdict.rationale: Glama Chat lets users upload their own documents and get AI-generated answers grounded in them with page references, which is a first-party way to get AI output from the user's data. There is no evidence of proactive insights or suggestions drawn from the user's product data, such as gateway logs, usage, or server metrics. Missing for 10: proactive AI-generated insights or suggestions, AI analysis of in-product data (logs/usage/servers), depth documentation, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Upload any PDF, Word doc, or text file. Get instant answers with exact page references.
Search across documents and chats. Save and tag important conversations.
